fields.label: Image
fields.name: block_image_content_image
fields.instructions: Upload an image to display in the block.

fields.label: Aspect Ratio
fields.name: block_image_content_aspect_ratio
fields.instructions: Choose the aspect ratio for the image.

choices.h-full: Fit height of content area / free

fields.label: Object Fit
fields.name: block_image_content_object_fit
fields.instructions: Choose how the image should fit within the block.

fields.label: Image Order
fields.name: block_image_content_image_order
fields.instructions: Check this box if you want the image to appear on the right side of the content.

fields.label: Break Out Image?
fields.name: block_image_content_image_break_out
fields.instructions: Check this box if you want the image to break out of the content container, and bleed to the edge of the screen.

fields.label: Mobile Image Order
fields.name: block_image_content_image_mobile_order
fields.instructions: Check this box if you want the image to appear above the content on mobile devices.
